knowledgePoints.title: 一、常见动词词块
knowledgePoints.content: 动词+介词/副词构成的固定搭配

subPoints.title: look词组
subPoints.content: look for 寻找, look after 照顾, look forward to 期待, look into 调查, look up 查阅

subPoints.title: get词组
subPoints.content: get up 起床, get along 相处, get over 克服, get through 通过, get rid of 摆脱

subPoints.title: take词组
subPoints.content: take off 起飞/脱下, take up 占据/开始从事, take part in 参加, take place 发生, take after 长得像

subPoints.title: break词组
subPoints.content: break out 爆发, break down 崩溃, break up 分手/解散, break into 闯入, break through 突破

subPoints.title: come词组
subPoints.content: come up with 提出, come across 偶遇, come true 实现, come out 出版/结果是, come down to 归结为

knowledgePoints.title: 二、常用介词短语
knowledgePoints.content: 介词+名词构成的固定搭配

subPoints.title: at短语
subPoints.content: at first 起初, at last 最后, at least 至少, at once 立刻, at present 现在

subPoints.title: in短语
subPoints.content: in charge of 负责, in danger 处于危险中, in need of 需要, in return 作为回报, in addition 此外

subPoints.title: on短语
subPoints.content: on duty 值班, on time 准时, on purpose 故意, on sale 出售, on behalf of 代表

subPoints.title: for短语
subPoints.content: for example 例如, for instance 例如, for good 永久, for sure 肯定, for free 免费

exercises.question: The scientists will ______ (进行实验) to test their hypothesis.
exercises.explanation: conduct an experiment 表示进行实验

exercises.question: If you don't study hard, you might ______ (落后) in the competition.
We should always ______ (信守承诺) to maintain trust.
exercises.explanation: keep a promise 表示信守承诺

exercises.question: The meeting was ______ (取消) because of the heavy rain.
______ (根据) the latest report, global temperatures are rising.
She managed to ______ after months of hard work.
exercises.explanation: make a difference 表示产生影响，取得成功

exercises.question: ______ his injury, he finished the marathon.
exercises.explanation: In spite of 表示尽管

exercises.question: The children ______ an old photo album in the attic.
To ______ this problem, we need more data.
"It's raining ______ . Don't go out!"
exercises.explanation: raining cats and dogs 表示下倾盆大雨
